pages.text: Storage Disks are portable storage devices that can be inserted into a $(l:disk_drive)Disk Drive$() to provide storage capacity for your network. These disks are essential components for any Refined Storage system, offering various storage tiers to meet different needs. Like Storage Blocks, they won't despawn when dropped in the world.

Storage Disks can be uncrafted by shift + right-clicking with them in hand, returning:$(br)$(li)The corresponding Storage Part$(li)Storage Housing$(br2)When inserted into a Disk Drive, the network gains access to the disk's storage capacity. Multiple disks can be used in a single drive to expand storage capabilities.$(br2)Available capacities:$(br)$(li)1k Storage Disk (1,000 items)$(li)4k Storage Disk (4,000 items)$(li)16k Storage Disk (16,000 items)$(li)64k Storage Disk (64,000 items)
